whatChanged.summary: A payment that fails is tried again up to three times before the order is given up.
caught: A retry could charge the card twice
whatChanged.laneReason: The change touches how payments are charged.

craft.title: Retries wait longer after each failure
craft.detail: A growing wait is the usual way to avoid hammering the bank.

craft.title: The retry limit lives in the shop settings
craft.detail: One place to change it without a release.

craft.title: Log lines name the order, not the card

alreadyDecided.title: A failed payment keeps its original order number
alreadyDecided.detail: Ruled earlier: the order number is the customer's receipt.

history: Shown wrong: The retry loop never stops. It stops after three tries; the reviewer misread the counter.
